138    /**
139     *Borrowed from lilneutility for performance enhancement for dashed lines.
140     * @param pt1
141     * @param pt2
142     * @param dist
143     * @return 
144     */
145    private static Point2D ExtendAlongLineDouble2(POINT2 pt1, POINT2 pt2, double dist) {
146        double x=0,y=0;
147        try {
148            double dOriginalDistance = CalcDistanceDouble(pt1, pt2);
149            if (dOriginalDistance == 0 || dist == 0) {
150                return new Point2D.Double(pt1.x,pt1.y);
151            }
152
153            x = (dist / dOriginalDistance * (pt2.x - pt1.x) + pt1.x);
154            y = (dist / dOriginalDistance * (pt2.y - pt1.y) + pt1.y);
155        } catch (Exception exc) {
156            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "ExtendAlongLineDouble2",
157                    new RendererException("Failed inside ExtendAlongLineDouble2", exc));
158        }
159        //return pt3;
160        return new Point2D.Double(x,y);
161    }

163    /**
164     * GE has no capability for dashed lines. This function sets each polyline in the array as a new
165     * polyline broken into points corresponding to the dash pattern
166     * @param polylines
167     * @param shape
168     */
169    private static void createDashedPolylines(TGLight tg, ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>polylines,ShapeInfo shape)
170    {
171        try
172        {
173            if(tg.get_UseDashArray()==true)
174                return;
175            if(shape.getLineColor()==null)
176                return;
177            ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>dashedPolylines=new ArrayList();
178            BasicStroke s=(BasicStroke)shape.getStroke();
179            float[]dash=s.getDashArray();
180            float lineThickness=tg.get_LineThickness();
181            if(dash==null || dash.length<2)
182                return;
183            
184            if(dash.length==8)//dotted line
185            {
186                dash=new float[2];
187                dash[0]=2f;
188                dash[1]=2f;  
189                s=new BasicStroke(2,BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND,BasicStroke.JOIN_MITER,2f,dash,0f);
190                shape.setStroke(s);
191            }
192            if(dash.length==4)
193            {
194                if(dash[0]==lineThickness*2f && dash[1]==lineThickness*2f && dash[2]==lineThickness*2f && dash[3]==lineThickness*2f)//this really looks awful in GE
195                {
196                    dash=new float[2];
197                    dash[0]=lineThickness;
198                    dash[1]=lineThickness;                      
199                }
200            }
201            
202            int j=0,k=0,i=0,l=0,n=0;
203            ArrayList<Point2D>polyline=null;
204            ArrayList<Point2D>dashedPolyline=null;
205            Point2D pt2d0=null,pt2d1=null,pt2d2=null,pt2d3=null;
206            POINT2 pt0=null,pt1=null,pt2=null,pt3=null;
207            double dist=0;
208            double patternLength=0;
209            int numSegments=0;
210            int t=dash.length;
211            
212            //add 3 lines for high resolution devices
213            double dashMultiplier=(double)RendererSettings.getInstance().getDeviceDPI()/96.0;
214            for(j=0;j<dash.length;j++)
215                dash[j]*=dashMultiplier;
216            //end section
217            
218            for(j=0;j<t;j++)
219                patternLength+=dash[j];
220            //sum is the end length of eash dash element
221            float sum[]=new float[dash.length];
222            double remainder=0;
223            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
224            t=sum.length;
225            //for(j=0;j<sum.length;j++)
226            for(j=0;j<t;j++)
227            {
228                for(k=0;k<=j;k++)
229                {
230                    sum[j]+=dash[k];
231                }
232            }
233
234            boolean noShortSegments=false;
235            switch(linetype)
236            {                
237                case TacticalLines.LINTGT:
238                case TacticalLines.LINTGTS:
239                case TacticalLines.FPF:
240                case TacticalLines.HWFENCE:
241                case TacticalLines.LWFENCE:
242                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEA:
243                case TacticalLines.DFENCE:
244                case TacticalLines.SFENCE:
245                case TacticalLines.UNSP:
246                    noShortSegments=true;
247                    break;
248                default:
249                    break;
250            }
251            t=polylines.size();
252            //for(j=0;j<polylines.size();j++)
253            for(j=0;j<t;j++)
254            {
255                polyline=polylines.get(j);
256                //diagnostic
257                //dashedPolyline=new ArrayList();
258                int u=polyline.size();
259                //for(k=0;k<polyline.size()-1;k++)
260                for(k=0;k<u-1;k++)
261                {
262                    pt2d0=polyline.get(k);
263                    pt2d1=polyline.get(k+1);
264                    pt0=new POINT2(pt2d0.getX(),pt2d0.getY());
265                    pt1=new POINT2(pt2d1.getX(),pt2d1.getY());
266                    dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
267                    numSegments=(int)(dist/patternLength);
268                    
269                    if(noShortSegments)
270                        if(dist<25)
271                            numSegments=1;
272                    
273                    for(l=0;l<numSegments;l++)
274                    {                        
275                        int v=dash.length;
276                        //for(i=0;i<dash.length;i++)
277                        for(i=0;i<v;i++)
278                        {
279                            if(i%2==0)
280                            {
281                                dashedPolyline=new ArrayList();
282                                if(i==0)
283                                {
284                                    //pt2=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pt1, l*patternLength);
285                                    pt2d2=ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pt1, l*patternLength);
286                                }
287                                else
288                                {
289                                    //pt2=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pt1, l*patternLength+sum[i-1]);
290                                    pt2d2=ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pt1, l*patternLength+sum[i-1]);
291                                }
292
293                                //pt3=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pt1, l*patternLength+sum[i]);
294                                pt2d3=ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pt1, l*patternLength+sum[i]);
295                                
296                                //diagnostic removed this for performance improvement above
297                                //convert pt2,pt3 to Point2D and add them to the replacement arraylist
298                                //pt2d2=new Point2D.Double(pt2.x,pt2.y);
299                                //pt2d3=new Point2D.Double(pt3.x,pt3.y);
300                                //end section
301                                
302                                dashedPolyline.add(pt2d2);
303                                dashedPolyline.add(pt2d3);
304                                //each one of these is only two points long, that is why it's a performance drag
305                                //diagnostic
306                                dashedPolylines.add(dashedPolyline);
307                            }
308                        }
309                    }//end l loop
310                    //for the remainder split the difference
311                    remainder=dist-numSegments*patternLength;
312                    if(remainder>0)
313                    {
314                        //diagnostic
315                        dashedPolyline=new ArrayList();
316                        //pt2=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pt1, numSegments*patternLength+remainder/2);
317                        //pt2d2=new Point2D.Double(pt2.x,pt2.y);
318                        pt2d2=ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pt1, numSegments*patternLength+remainder/2);
319                        dashedPolyline.add(pt2d1);
320                        dashedPolyline.add(pt2d2);
321                        //diagnostic
322                        dashedPolylines.add(dashedPolyline);
323                    }
324                }//end k loop
325                //previousPolyline=polylines.set(j, dashedPolyline);
326            }//end j loop
327            polylines.clear();
328            //diagnostic comment one line
329            polylines.addAll(dashedPolylines);
330            //polylines.add(dashedPolyline);
331        }
332        catch (Exception exc) {
333            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "createDashedPolylines",
334                    new RendererException("Failed inside createDashedPolylines", exc));
335        }
336    }
337    private static ShapeInfo createSimpleFillShape(TGLight tg,ShapeInfo shape,ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>polylines)
338    {
339        try
340        {
341            BasicStroke s=(BasicStroke)shape.getStroke();
342            float[]dash=s.getDashArray();
343            if(armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(tg.get_LineType())==false)
344                if(armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.IsChange1Area(tg.get_LineType(), null)==false)
345                    return null;
346            if(dash==null || dash.length<2)
347                return null;   
348            if(shape.getFillColor()==null)
349                return null;
350            
351            //if we reach this point we know it is a dashed line so we need a separate fill shape
352            int j=0,k=0;
353            ShapeInfo shape2=new ShapeInfo(shape.getShape());
354            shape2.setShapeType(ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL);
355            ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>polylines2=new ArrayList();
356            ArrayList<Point2D>polyline=null,polyline2=null;
357            Point2D pt2d=null;
358            s=new BasicStroke(0);
359            shape2.setStroke(s);
360            shape2.setFillColor(shape.getFillColor());            
361            int n=polylines.size();
362            //for(j=0;j<polylines.size();j++)
363            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
364            {
365                polyline=polylines.get(j);
366                polyline2=new ArrayList();
367                int t=polyline.size();
368                //for(k=0;k<polyline.size();k++)
369                for(k=0;k<t;k++)
370                {
371                    pt2d=new Point2D.Double(polyline.get(k).getX(),polyline.get(k).getY());
372                    polyline2.add(pt2d);
373                }
374                polylines2.add(polyline2);
375            }
376            //reset our original dashed shapinfo type to polyline
377            shape.setShapeType(ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
378            //this line will prevent unecessary work by multipointhandler
379            shape.setFillColor(null);
380            shape2.setPolylines(polylines2);            
381//            shape2.setAffineTransform(new AffineTransform());
382            return shape2;
383        }
384        catch (Exception exc) {
385            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "createSimpleFillShape",
386                    new RendererException("Failed inside createSimpleFillShape", exc));
387        }
388        return null;
389    }
390    private static boolean allowFillForThese(TGLight tg)
391    {
392        try
393        {
394            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
395            int bolMETOC=clsMETOC.IsWeather(tg.get_SymbolId());
396            if(bolMETOC >= 0)            
397                return true;            
398
399            switch(linetype)
400            {
401                case TacticalLines.BBS_AREA:
402                case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
403                    
404                case TacticalLines.CATK:
405                case TacticalLines.CATKBYFIRE:
406                case TacticalLines.AAFNT:
407                case TacticalLines.AXAD:
408                case TacticalLines.AIRAOA:
409                case TacticalLines.AAAAA:
410                case TacticalLines.MAIN:
411                case TacticalLines.SPT:
412                
413                case TacticalLines.SARA:
414                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR:
415                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN:
416                case TacticalLines.MNFLDFIX:
417                case TacticalLines.TURN:
418                case TacticalLines.MNFLDDIS:
419                //case TacticalLines.OVERHEAD_WIRE:
420                case TacticalLines.OVERHEAD_WIRE_LS:
421                case TacticalLines.EASY:
422                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHC:
423                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHM:
424                case TacticalLines.FERRY:
425                case TacticalLines.BYDIF:
426                case TacticalLines.BYIMP:
427                case TacticalLines.DEPTH_AREA:
428                    return true;
429                default:
430                    return false;
431            }
432        }
433        catch (Exception exc) {
434            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "allowFillForThese",
435                    new RendererException("Failed inside allowFillForThese", exc));
436        }
437        return false;
438    }
439    protected static void SetShapeInfosPolylines(TGLight tg, ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapeInfos, Object clipBounds)
440    {
441        try
442        {
443            int j=0;
444            Shape shape=null;
445            ShapeInfo shapeInfo=null;
446            ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>polylines=null;
447            int type=-1;
448            ShapeInfo simpleFillShape =null;//diagnostic
449            Boolean isClosed=armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(tg.get_LineType());
450            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
451            Color fillColor=null;
452            int n=shapeInfos.size();
453            //for(j=0;j<shapeInfos.size();j++)
454            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
455            {
456                shapeInfo=shapeInfos.get(j);
457                type=shapeInfo.getShapeType();
458                shape=shapeInfo.getShape();
459                if(isClosed==false && type != Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL)
460                    polylines=createRenderablesFromShape(tg,shape,type,clipBounds);
461                else
462                    polylines=createRenderablesFromShape(tg,shape,type,null);
463                //create a simple fill shape here and change the shape type to SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE if it has non-null dash
464                //add the simple fill shape to shapeInfos after the loop
465                if(simpleFillShape==null)
466                    simpleFillShape=createSimpleFillShape(tg,shapeInfo,polylines);
467                
468                fillColor=shapeInfo.getFillColor();
469                //if(simpleFillShape!=null || fillColor != null)//the symbol has a basic fill shape
470                if(simpleFillShape!=null)//the symbol has a basic fill shape
471                    if(allowFillForThese(tg)==false)
472                        shapeInfo.setFillColor(null);
473                
474                //commenting the following line means the client will have to calculate the dashed lines
475                //and will get a performance enhancement by doing so.
476                //uncommenting will cause the renderer to calculate the dashed line segments
477                createDashedPolylines(tg, polylines,shapeInfo);
478                
479                shapeInfo.setPolylines(polylines);
480            }            
481            if(simpleFillShape != null)
482                shapeInfos.add(0,simpleFillShape);
483        }
484        catch (Exception exc) {
485            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "SetShapeInfosPolylines",
486                    new RendererException("Failed inside SetShapeInfosPolylines", exc));
487        }
488    }
489    /**
490     * Separates the Shape into separate polylines, eas as an ArrayList of Point2D
491     * @param shape
492     * @return
493     */
494    private static ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>createRenderablesFromShape(TGLight tg, Shape shape, int shapeType, Object clipArea)
495    {
496        ArrayList<Point2D> ptsPoly=new ArrayList();
497        ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>polylines2=new ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>();
498        Point2D ptPoly=null;        
499        try 
500        {
501            //this is not going to work for splines
502            float[] coords = new float[6];
503            for (PathIterator i = shape.getPathIterator(null); !i.isDone(); i.next())
504            {
505                int type = i.currentSegment(coords);
506                switch (type) {
507                    case PathIterator.SEG_MOVETO:
508                        //newshape.moveTo(coords[0], coords[1]);
509                        //finalize the last Polyline and add it to the array
510                        if(ptsPoly.size()>0)
511                        {
512                            if(shapeType==ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL)
513                            {
514                                if(ptsPoly.get(ptsPoly.size()-1).getX() != ptsPoly.get(0).getX() || 
515                                        ptsPoly.get(ptsPoly.size()-1).getY() != ptsPoly.get(0).getY() )
516                                {
517                                    Point2D pt2d=new Point2D.Double(ptsPoly.get(0).getX(), ptsPoly.get(0).getY());
518                                    ptsPoly.add(pt2d);
519                                }
520                            }                           
521                            if(ptsPoly.size()>1)
522                                polylines2.add(ptsPoly);
523                        }
524                        //start the ArrayList for next Polyline                       
525                        ptsPoly=new ArrayList();
526                        ptPoly=new Point2D.Double(coords[0], coords[1]);
527                        ptsPoly.add(ptPoly);
528                        break;
529                    case PathIterator.SEG_LINETO:
530                        //newshape.lineTo(coords[0], coords[1]);
531                        ptPoly=new Point2D.Double(coords[0],coords[1]);
532                        ptsPoly.add(ptPoly);                        
533                        break;
534                    case PathIterator.SEG_QUADTO: //quadTo was never used
535                        //no idea what to do with this
536                        //newshape.quadTo(coords[0], coords[1], coords[2], coords[3]);
537                        break;
538                    case PathIterator.SEG_CUBICTO:  //curveTo was used for HOLD, BRDGHD and some METOC's
539                        //no idea what to do with these
540                        //newshape.curveTo(coords[0], coords[1], coords[2], coords[3],
541                        //        coords[4], coords[5]);
542                        break;
543                    case PathIterator.SEG_CLOSE:    //closePath was never used
544                        //newshape.closePath();
545                        break;
546                }
547            }
548            if(ptsPoly.size()>1)
549            {
550                //add the last line to the ArrayList
551                //if it is a fill shape then the Google Earth linear ring requires the last point be added
552                if(shapeType==ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL)
553                {
554                    if(ptsPoly.get(ptsPoly.size()-1).getX() != ptsPoly.get(0).getX() || 
555                            ptsPoly.get(ptsPoly.size()-1).getY() != ptsPoly.get(0).getY() )
556                    {
557                        Point2D pt2d=new Point2D.Double(ptsPoly.get(0).getX(), ptsPoly.get(0).getY());
558                        ptsPoly.add(pt2d);
559                    }
560                }
561                polylines2.add(ptsPoly);                
562            }
563        }
564        catch (Exception exc) {
565            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "createRenderableFromShape",
566                    new RendererException("Failed inside createRenderableFromShape", exc));
567        }
568        //return newshape;
569        return polylines2;
570    }   
571    /**
572     * Assumes a convex polygon for the clipping area.
573     * expand the polygon using pixels and a similar algorithm to what flash renderer does for DEPTH AREA
574     * @param pts clipping area to expand
575     * @param expand pixels expansion
576     * @return
577     */
578    protected static ArrayList<Point2D>expandPolygon(ArrayList<Point2D>pts,
579            double expand)
580    {
581        ArrayList<Point2D>lgPoly=null;
582        try
583        {
584            int j=0;
585            Point2D[]destPts=null;
586            boolean isClosed=false;
587            if(pts.get(pts.size()-1).getX()==pts.get(0).getX() && pts.get(pts.size()-1).getY()==pts.get(0).getY())
588            {
589                pts.remove(pts.size()-1);
590                isClosed=true;
591            }
592            ArrayList<POINT2>pts2=clsUtility.Points2DToPOINT2(pts);
593            POINT2 pt0=null,pt1=null,pt2=null,pt3=null;
594            double m=0,m1=0,b=0,b1=0;
595            ArrayList<Line2D>lineSegments=new ArrayList();
596            //n vertical segments
597            int n=pts2.size();
598            //for(j=0;j<pts2.size()-1;j++)
599            for(j=0;j<n-1;j++)
600            {
601                pt0=new POINT2(pts2.get(j));
602                pt1=new POINT2(pts2.get(j+1));
603                //no vertical segments
604                if(pt0.x==pt1.x)
605                {
606                    pt1.x+=1;                                
607                    pts2.set(j+1, pt1);
608                }
609            }
610            POINT2 ptn=pts2.get(pts2.size()-1);
611            pt0=new POINT2(pts2.get(0));
612            //last segment not vertical
613            if(ptn.x==pt0.x)
614            {
615                ptn.x+=1;
616                pts2.set(pts2.size()-1, ptn);
617            }
618            //close pts2
619            pts2.add(pt0);;
620            
621            //POINT2 ptOther=null;
622            //int quadrant=-1,otherQuadrant=-1;
623            Polygon poly=new Polygon();
624            n=pts2.size();
625            //for(j=0;j<pts2.size();j++)
626            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
627                poly.addPoint((int)pts2.get(j).x, (int)pts2.get(j).y);
628            
629            Line2D lineSegment=null;
630            POINT2 midPt=null;
631            //pts2 is closed
632            n=pts2.size();
633            //for(j=0;j<pts2.size()-1;j++)
634            for(j=0;j<n-1;j++)
635            {                
636                pt0=new POINT2(pts2.get(j));
637                pt1=new POINT2(pts2.get(j+1));                
638                m=(pt0.y-pt1.y)/(pt0.x-pt1.x);
639                //m1=-1/m;
640                if(Math.abs(m)<1)
641                {
642                    pt2=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt0, lineutility.extend_above, expand);
643                    pt3=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt1, lineutility.extend_above, expand);
644                    midPt=lineutility.MidPointDouble(pt2, pt3, 0);
645                    //we want the polygon to not contain the extended points
646                    if(poly.contains(midPt.x, midPt.y))
647                    {
648                        pt2=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt0, lineutility.extend_below, expand);
649                        pt3=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt1, lineutility.extend_below, expand);                        
650                    }                                        
651                }
652                else
653                {
654                    pt2=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt0, lineutility.extend_left, expand);
655                    pt3=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt1, lineutility.extend_left, expand);
656                    midPt=lineutility.MidPointDouble(pt2, pt3, 0);
657                    //we want the polygon to not contain the extended points
658                    if(poly.contains(midPt.x, midPt.y))
659                    {
660                        pt2=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt0, lineutility.extend_right, expand);
661                        pt3=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt1, lineutility.extend_right, expand);                        
662                    }                                                            
663                }
664                lineSegment=new Line2D.Double(pt2.x, pt2.y, pt3.x, pt3.y);
665                lineSegments.add(lineSegment);
666            }
667            //we will intersect the line segments to form an expanded polygon
668            ArrayList<POINT2> expandPts=new ArrayList();
669            Line2D thisLine=null,nextLine=null;
670            double x1=0,y1=0,x2=0,y2=0,x=0,y=0;
671            int t=lineSegments.size();
672            //for(j=0;j<lineSegments.size();j++)
673            for(j=0;j<t;j++)
674            {
675                thisLine=lineSegments.get(j);
676                x1=thisLine.getX1();
677                y1=thisLine.getY1();
678                x2=thisLine.getX2();
679                y2=thisLine.getY2();
680                //thisLine line equation
681                m=(y1-y2)/(x1-x2);
682                b=y1-m*x1;
683                
684                if(j==lineSegments.size()-1)
685                    nextLine=lineSegments.get(0);
686                else
687                    nextLine=lineSegments.get(j+1);
688                
689                x1=nextLine.getX1();
690                y1=nextLine.getY1();
691                x2=nextLine.getX2();
692                y2=nextLine.getY2();
693                //nextLine line equation
694                m1=(y1-y2)/(x1-x2);
695                b1=y1-m1*x1;
696                
697                //intersect thisLine with nextLine
698                if(m != m1)
699                {
700                    x=(b1-b)/(m-m1);    //cannot blow up
701                    y=(m*x+b);
702                }
703                else    //this should not happen
704                {
705                    x=thisLine.getX2();
706                    y=thisLine.getY2();
707                }
708                expandPts.add(new POINT2(x,y));
709            }           
710            lgPoly=new ArrayList();
711            t=expandPts.size();
712            //for(j=0;j<expandPts.size();j++)            
713            for(j=0;j<t;j++)            
714                lgPoly.add(new Point2D.Double(expandPts.get(j).x, expandPts.get(j).y));
715            
716            //close the aray if the original clipping array if applicable
717            if(isClosed)
718                lgPoly.add( new Point2D.Double( lgPoly.get(0).getX(),lgPoly.get(0).getY() ) );
719        }
720        catch (Exception exc) 
721        {
722            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "expandPolygon2",
723                    new RendererException("Failed inside expandPolygon2", exc));
724        }
725        return lgPoly;
726    }

783            lgPoly=new ArrayList<Point2D>();

1034    /**
1035     * removes leading or trailing segments after the points were clipped
1036     * @param tg
1037     * @param clipArea 
1038     */
1039    protected static void removeTrailingPoints(TGLight tg, Object clipArea)
1040    {
1041        try
1042        {
1043            boolean isClosed=armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(tg.get_LineType());
1044            if(isClosed)
1045                return;
1046            
1047            Polygon poly=new Polygon();
1048            Area area=null;
1049            Rectangle2D clipBounds=null;
1050            ArrayList<Point2D>clipPoints=null;
1051            Point2D pt2d=null;
1052            int j=0;
1053            if(clipArea==null)
1054                return;
1055
1056            if(clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class))
1057            {
1058                clipBounds=(Rectangle2D.Double)clipArea;
1059            }
1060            else if(clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class))
1061            {
1062                //clipBounds=(Rectangle2D)clipArea;
1063                Rectangle rectx=(Rectangle)clipArea;
1064                clipBounds=new Rectangle2D.Double(rectx.x,rectx.y,rectx.width,rectx.height);
1065            }
1066            else if(clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class))
1067            {
1068                clipPoints=(ArrayList<Point2D>)clipArea;            
1069            }
1070            if(clipBounds != null)
1071            {
1072                clipPoints=new ArrayList<Point2D>();
1073                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(clipBounds.getX(),clipBounds.getY()));                
1074                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(clipBounds.getX()+clipBounds.getWidth(),clipBounds.getY()));                
1075                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(clipBounds.getX()+clipBounds.getWidth(),clipBounds.getY()+clipBounds.getHeight()));                
1076                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(clipBounds.getX(),clipBounds.getY()+clipBounds.getHeight()));                
1077                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(clipBounds.getX(),clipBounds.getY()));                
1078            }   
1079
1080            Point2D ptLast=clipPoints.get(clipPoints.size()-1);
1081            Point2D pt02d=clipPoints.get(0);
1082            Point2D pt12d=null;
1083            //close the area
1084            if(pt02d.getX() != ptLast.getX() || pt02d.getY() != ptLast.getY())
1085            {
1086                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(pt02d.getX(),pt02d.getY()));
1087                //poly.addPoint((int)pt02d.getX(),(int)pt02d.getY());
1088            }
1089            //fill the polygon
1090            int n=clipPoints.size();
1091            //for(j=0;j<clipPoints.size();j++)
1092            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
1093            {
1094                pt02d=clipPoints.get(j);            
1095                poly.addPoint((int)pt02d.getX(), (int)pt02d.getY());
1096            }
1097            area=new Area(poly);
1098            Line2D line=null;
1099            POINT2 pt0=null,pt1=null;
1100            boolean intersects=false;
1101            int frontIndex=0,backIndex=tg.Pixels.size()-1;
1102            //breaks at the first leading segment that intersects the clip area
1103            n=tg.Pixels.size();
1104            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size()-1;j++)
1105            for(j=0;j<n-1;j++)
1106            {
1107               pt0=tg.Pixels.get(j);
1108               pt1=tg.Pixels.get(j+1);
1109               line=new Line2D.Double(pt0.x, pt0.y, pt1.x, pt1.y);
1110               intersects=lineIntersectsClipArea(line, clipPoints);
1111               if(intersects==true)
1112               {
1113                   frontIndex=j;
1114                   break;
1115               }
1116               else if(area.contains((int)pt0.x,(int)pt0.y) || area.contains((int)pt1.x,(int)pt1.y))
1117               {
1118                   frontIndex=j;
1119                   break;               
1120               }           
1121            }
1122            //breaks at the first trailing segment that intersects the clip area
1123            n=tg.Pixels.size();
1124            //for(j=tg.Pixels.size()-1;j>0;j--)
1125            for(j=n-1;j>0;j--)
1126            {
1127               pt0=tg.Pixels.get(j);
1128               pt1=tg.Pixels.get(j-1);
1129               line=new Line2D.Double(pt0.x, pt0.y, pt1.x, pt1.y);
1130               intersects=lineIntersectsClipArea(line, clipPoints);
1131               if(intersects==true)
1132               {
1133                   backIndex=j;
1134                   break;
1135               }
1136               else if(area.contains((int)pt0.x,(int)pt0.y) || area.contains((int)pt1.x,(int)pt1.y))
1137               {
1138                   backIndex=j;
1139                   break;               
1140               }           
1141            }
1142            ArrayList<POINT2>pts=new ArrayList();
1143            for(j=frontIndex;j<=backIndex;j++)
1144            {
1145                pt0=new POINT2(tg.Pixels.get(j));
1146                pts.add(pt0);
1147            }
1148            tg.Pixels=pts;           
1149        }
1150        catch(Exception exc)
1151        {
1152            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer" ,"removeTrailingPoints",
1153                    new RendererException("Failed inside removeTrailingPoints", exc));
1154        }
1155    }
1156/**
1157     * tests of a Line2D intersects a polygon by using line.intersectsLine on each segment of the polygon
1158     * assumes clip clipping area was parsed to shift points of vertical segments to make them not vertical
1159     * @param line a clipping line in the clipping polygon
1160     * @param clipPts array of clip points assumed to be closed
1161     * @return true if the line intersects the clip bounds
1162     */
1163    private static boolean lineIntersectsClipArea(Line2D line, 
1164            ArrayList<Point2D> clipPts)
1165    {
1166        boolean result=false;
1167        try
1168        {
1169            int j=0;           
1170            
1171            //test if polygon contains an end point
1172            Polygon poly=new Polygon();
1173            int n=clipPts.size();
1174            //for(j=0;j<clipPts.size();j++)            
1175            for(j=0;j<n;j++)            
1176                poly.addPoint((int)clipPts.get(j).getX(),(int)clipPts.get(j).getY());
1177            
1178            if(poly.contains(line.getX1(),line.getY1()))
1179                return true;
1180            if(poly.contains(line.getX2(),line.getY2()))
1181                return true;
1182            //end section
1183            
1184            Line2D currentSegment=null;
1185            n=clipPts.size();
1186            //for(j=0;j<clipPts.size()-1;j++)
1187            for(j=0;j<n-1;j++)
1188            {
1189                currentSegment=new Line2D.Double(clipPts.get(j).getX(),clipPts.get(j).getY(),clipPts.get(j+1).getX(),clipPts.get(j+1).getY());
1190                if(line.intersectsLine(currentSegment)==true)
1191                    return true;            
1192            }
1193            //if the clipPts are not closed then the above loop did not test the closing segment            
1194            Point2D pt0=clipPts.get(0);
1195            Point2D ptLast=clipPts.get(clipPts.size()-1);
1196            //int n=clipPts.size()-1;            
1197            if(pt0.getX()!=ptLast.getX() || pt0.getY()!=ptLast.getY())
1198            {
1199                //currentSegment=new Line2D.Double(clipPts.get(n).getX(),clipPts.get(n).getY(),clipPts.get(0).getX(),clipPts.get(0).getY());
1200                currentSegment=new Line2D.Double(ptLast.getX(),ptLast.getY(),pt0.getX(),pt0.getY());
1201                if(line.intersectsLine(currentSegment)==true)
1202                    return true;                            
1203            }
1204        }
1205        catch (Exception exc) {
1206            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "lineIntersectsClipArea",
1207                    new RendererException("Failed inside lineIntersectsClipArea", exc));
1208        }
1209        return result;
1210    }
1211    /*
1212     * GE has no hatch utility.
1213     */
1214    protected static void buildHatchFills(TGLight tg, ArrayList<ShapeInfo>shapes)
1215    {
1216        try
1217       {
1218            if(shapes==null || shapes.size()==0)
1219                return;
1220//            if(tg.get_UseHatchFill())
1221//                return;
1222            
1223            int lineType=tg.get_LineType();            
1224            int hatch=tg.get_FillStyle();
1225            int j=0,hatch2=0;
1226            Shape2 shape2=null;
1227            int index=0;
1228//            if(armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(lineType)==false)
1229//                if(armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.IsChange1Area(lineType, null)==false)
1230//                    return;
1231            if(armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(lineType)==false)
1232            {
1233                if(armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.IsChange1Area(lineType, null)==false)
1234                {
1235                    //return;
1236                    switch(lineType)
1237                    {
1238                        case TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE:
1239                        case TacticalLines.PBS_ELLIPSE:
1240                        case TacticalLines.BBS_AREA:
1241                        case TacticalLines.BBS_LINE:
1242                        case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
1243                            break;
1244                        default:
1245                            return;
1246                    }
1247                }
1248            }
1249
1250            switch(lineType)
1251            {
1252                case TacticalLines.NFA:
1253                case TacticalLines.NFA_CIRCULAR:
1254                case TacticalLines.NFA_RECTANGULAR:
1255                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_RECTANGULAR:
1256                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_RECTANGULAR:
1257                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_CIRCULAR:
1258                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_CIRCULAR:
1259                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE:
1260                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE:
1261                case TacticalLines.BIO:
1262                case TacticalLines.CHEM:
1263                case TacticalLines.RAD:
1264                case TacticalLines.WFZ:
1265                //case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
1266                case TacticalLines.LAA:
1267                    hatch=Hatch_BackwardDiagonal;
1268                    break;
1269                case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
1270                    //CPOF client required adding a simple shape for
1271                    //setting texturepaint which SECRenderer does not use
1272                    for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
1273                    {
1274                        ShapeInfo shape=shapes.get(j);
1275                        Color color=shape.getLineColor();
1276                        if(color==null)
1277                            continue;
1278                        //if(shape.getLineColor().getRGB()==0)
1279                        if(shape.getLineColor().toARGB()==0)
1280                            shapes.remove(j);
1281                    }
1282                    hatch=Hatch_BackwardDiagonal;
1283                    break;
1284                default:
1285                    if(hatch<=0)
1286                        return;
1287                    break;
1288            }
1289            //get the index of the shape with the same fillstyle
1290            int n=shapes.size();
1291            //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
1292            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
1293            {                
1294                shape2=(Shape2)shapes.get(j);
1295                hatch2=shape2.get_FillStyle();
1296                if(hatch2==hatch)
1297                {
1298                    index=j;
1299                    break;
1300                }
1301            }
1302            n=shapes.size();
1303            float hatchLineThickness=Math.round(tg.get_LineThickness()/2);
1304            //for(int k=0;k<shapes.size();k++)
1305            for(int k=0;k<n;k++)
1306            {
1307                //the outline should always be the 0th shape for areas
1308                ShapeInfo shape=null;
1309                if(lineType==TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN || lineType==TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR)
1310                {
1311                    shape=shapes.get(k);
1312                    shape2=(Shape2)shapes.get(k);
1313                    hatch=shape2.get_FillStyle();
1314                }                    
1315                else
1316                    shape=shapes.get(index);
1317                
1318                if(hatch<Hatch_ForwardDiagonal)//Hatch_ForwardDiagonal is the 0th hatch element
1319                    continue;
1320                
1321                if(hatch != Hatch_Cross)
1322                {
1323                    Shape2 shape3=buildHatchFill(tg, shape,hatch);
1324                    //shape.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1));
1325                    shape3.setStroke(new BasicStroke(hatchLineThickness));
1326                    shape3.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
1327                    shapes.add(shape3);
1328                }
1329                else    //cross hatch
1330                {
1331                    Shape2 shapeBk=buildHatchFill(tg, shape,Hatch_BackwardDiagonal);
1332                    Shape2 shapeFwd=buildHatchFill(tg, shape,Hatch_ForwardDiagonal);
1333                    //shapeBk.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1));
1334                    shapeBk.setStroke(new BasicStroke(hatchLineThickness));
1335                    shapeBk.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
1336                    shapes.add(shapeBk);
1337                    //shapeFwd.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1));
1338                    shapeFwd.setStroke(new BasicStroke(hatchLineThickness));
1339                    shapeFwd.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
1340                    shapes.add(shapeFwd);
1341                }
1342                if(lineType != TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN && lineType != TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR)
1343                    break;
1344            }
1345       }
1346        catch (Exception exc) {
1347            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "buildHatchFills",
1348                    new RendererException("Failed inside buildHatcHFills", exc));
1349        }
1350    }
1351    /*
1352     * GE has no hatch utility, we need to create a shape the client can use as hatch fill
1353     */
1354    protected static Shape2 buildHatchFill(TGLight tg, ShapeInfo shape, int hatch)
1355    {
1356        Shape2 hatchLineShape=null;
1357        try
1358        {
1359            hatchLineShape=new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
1360            Area hatchLineArea=null;
1361            Rectangle rect=shape.getBounds();
1362            double x0=rect.getX();
1363            double y0=rect.getY();
1364            double width=rect.getWidth();
1365            double height=rect.getHeight();
1366            //we need a square
1367            if(width>height)
1368                height=width;
1369            else
1370                width=height;
1371            
1372            //diagnostic
1373            if(tg.get_UseHatchFill())
1374            {
1375//                hatchLineShape.moveTo(new POINT2(x0,y0));
1376//                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width,y0));
1377//                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width,y0+width));
1378//                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0,y0+width));
1379                hatchLineShape.set_Fillstyle(hatch);
1380//                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0,y0));
1381//                Area shapeArea=new Area(shape.getShape());
1382//                hatchLineArea=new Area(hatchLineShape.getShape());
1383//                //intersect the hatch lines with the original shape area to get the fill
1384//                hatchLineArea.intersect(shapeArea);
1385//                hatchLineShape.setShape(hatchLineArea);
1386                hatchLineShape.setShape(lineutility.createStrokedShape(shape.getShape()));                                    
1387                return hatchLineShape;
1388            }
1389            //end section
1390
1391            width *= 2;
1392            height *= 2;
1393            //the next two values should be equal
1394            int horizLimit=0;
1395            int vertLimit=0;
1396            int j=0;
1397            ArrayList<POINT2>vertPts=new ArrayList();
1398            ArrayList<POINT2>horizPts=new ArrayList();
1399            POINT2 vertPt=null,horizPt=null;
1400            if(hatch==Hatch_BackwardDiagonal)
1401            {
1402                horizLimit=(int)(width/20.0);
1403                vertLimit=(int)(height/20.0);
1404                for(j=0;j<vertLimit;j++)
1405                {
1406                    vertPt=new POINT2(x0,y0+20*j);
1407                    vertPts.add(vertPt);
1408                }
1409                for(j=0;j<horizLimit;j++)
1410                {
1411                    horizPt=new POINT2(x0+20*j,y0);
1412                    horizPts.add(horizPt);
1413                }
1414
1415                hatchLineShape.moveTo(new POINT2(x0-10,y0-10));
1416                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0,y0));
1417                for(j=0;j<vertLimit;j++)
1418                {
1419                    if(j%2==0)
1420                    {
1421                        hatchLineShape.lineTo(vertPts.get(j));
1422                        hatchLineShape.lineTo(horizPts.get(j));
1423                    }
1424                    else
1425                    {
1426                        hatchLineShape.lineTo(horizPts.get(j));
1427                        hatchLineShape.lineTo(vertPts.get(j));
1428                    }
1429                }
1430                //go outside the bottom right corner to complete a valid area
1431                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width+10,y0+height+10));
1432                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width+20,y0+height+10));
1433                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width+20,y0-10));
1434                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0-10,y0-10));
1435            }
1436            if(hatch==Hatch_ForwardDiagonal)
1437            {
1438                horizLimit=(int)(width/20.0);
1439                vertLimit=(int)(height/20.0);
1440                width /= 2;
1441                for(j=0;j<vertLimit;j++)
1442                {
1443                    vertPt=new POINT2(x0+width,y0+20*j);
1444                    vertPts.add(vertPt);
1445                }
1446                for(j=0;j<horizLimit;j++)
1447                {
1448                    horizPt=new POINT2(x0+width-20*j,y0);
1449                    horizPts.add(horizPt);
1450                }
1451
1452                hatchLineShape.moveTo(new POINT2(x0+width+10,y0-10));
1453                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0,y0));
1454                for(j=0;j<vertLimit;j++)
1455                {
1456                    if(j%2==0)
1457                    {
1458                        hatchLineShape.lineTo(vertPts.get(j));
1459                        hatchLineShape.lineTo(horizPts.get(j));
1460                    }
1461                    else
1462                    {
1463                        hatchLineShape.lineTo(horizPts.get(j));
1464                        hatchLineShape.lineTo(vertPts.get(j));
1465                    }
1466                }
1467                //go outside the bottom left corner to complete a valid area
1468                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0-10,y0+height+10));
1469                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0-20,y0+height+10));
1470                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0-20,y0-10));
1471                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width+10,y0-10));
1472            }
1473            if(hatch==Hatch_Vertical)
1474            {
1475                horizLimit=(int)(width/10.0);
1476                vertLimit=(int)(height/10.0);
1477                for(j=0;j<horizLimit;j++)
1478                {
1479                    if(j%2==0)
1480                    {
1481                        vertPt=new POINT2(x0+10*j,y0);
1482                        vertPts.add(vertPt);
1483                        vertPt=new POINT2(x0+10*j,y0+height);
1484                        vertPts.add(vertPt);
1485                    }
1486                    else
1487                    {
1488                        vertPt=new POINT2(x0+10*j,y0+height);
1489                        vertPts.add(vertPt);
1490                        vertPt=new POINT2(x0+10*j,y0);
1491                        vertPts.add(vertPt);
1492                    }
1493                }
1494                hatchLineShape.moveTo(new POINT2(x0-10,y0-10));
1495                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0,y0));
1496                for(j=0;j<vertLimit-1;j++)
1497                {
1498                    hatchLineShape.lineTo(vertPts.get(j));
1499                }
1500                //go outside the bottom right corner to complete a valid area
1501                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width+10,y0+height+10));
1502                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width+20,y0+height+10));
1503                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width+20,y0-10));
1504                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0-10,y0-10));
1505            }
1506            if(hatch==Hatch_Horizontal)
1507            {
1508                horizLimit=(int)(width/10.0);
1509                vertLimit=(int)(height/10.0);
1510                for(j=0;j<vertLimit;j++)
1511                {
1512                    if(j%2==0)
1513                    {
1514                        horizPt=new POINT2(x0,y0+10*j);
1515                        horizPts.add(horizPt);
1516                        horizPt=new POINT2(x0+width,y0+10*j);
1517                        horizPts.add(horizPt);
1518                    }
1519                    else
1520                    {
1521                        horizPt=new POINT2(x0+width,y0+10*j);
1522                        horizPts.add(horizPt);
1523                        horizPt=new POINT2(x0,y0+10*j);
1524                        horizPts.add(horizPt);
1525                    }
1526                }
1527                hatchLineShape.moveTo(new POINT2(x0-10,y0-10));
1528                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0,y0));
1529                for(j=0;j<vertLimit-1;j++)
1530                {
1531                    hatchLineShape.lineTo(horizPts.get(j));
1532                }
1533                //go outside the bottom left corner to complete a valid area
1534                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0-10,y0+height+10));
1535                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0-20,y0+height+10));
1536                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0-20,y0-10));
1537                hatchLineShape.lineTo(new POINT2(x0+width+10,y0-10));
1538            }
1539
1540            Area shapeArea=new Area(shape.getShape());
1541            hatchLineArea=new Area(hatchLineShape.getShape());
1542            //intersect the hatch lines with the original shape area to get the fill
1543            hatchLineArea.intersect(shapeArea);
1544            hatchLineShape.setShape(hatchLineArea);
1545            //return null;
1546        }
1547        catch(Exception exc)
1548        {
1549            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "buildHatchArea",
1550                    new RendererException("Failed inside buildHatchArea", exc));
1551        }
1552        return hatchLineShape;
1553    }
1554    /**
1555     * returns true if segment data set for MSR, ASR, Boundary
1556     * @param tg
1557     * @return 
1558     */
1559    protected static boolean segmentColorsSet(TGLight tg)
1560    {
1561        try
1562        {
1563            switch(tg.get_LineType())
1564            {
1565                case TacticalLines.BOUNDARY:
1566                case TacticalLines.MSR:
1567                case TacticalLines.ASR:
1568                    break;
1569                default:
1570                    return false;
1571            }
1572            String strH=tg.get_H();
1573            if(strH==null || strH.isEmpty())
1574                return false;
1575            String[] strs=strH.split(",");
1576            if(strs.length>1)
1577                return true;            
1578        }
1579        catch(Exception exc)
1580        {
1581            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "segmentColorsSet",
1582                    new RendererException("Failed inside segmentColorsSet", exc));
1583        }
1584        return false;
1585    }
1586    /**
1587     * Use clipping rectangle or clip points to build a zoom factor if the client zoomed in after the initial render.
1588     * Multiply the geo segmenting interval by this factor.
1589     * @param rect
1590     * @param clipPoints
1591     * @param pixels
1592     * @return 
1593     */
1594    protected static double getZoomFactor(Rectangle2D rect, ArrayList<Point2D> clipPoints, ArrayList<POINT2>pixels)
1595    {
1596        double factor=-1;
1597        try
1598        {
1599            if(pixels==null || pixels.size()<2)
1600                return factor;
1601            if(clipPoints==null && rect==null)
1602                return factor;
1603            double maxLengthPixels=0, maxLengthClipArea=0,temp=0;
1604            int j=0;
1605            Point2D pt2d0=null,pt2d1=null;POINT2 pt0=null, pt1=null;
1606            for(j=0;j<pixels.size()-1;j++)
1607            {
1608               pt0=pixels.get(j);
1609               pt1=pixels.get(j+1);
1610               temp=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
1611               if(temp>maxLengthPixels)
1612                   maxLengthPixels=temp;
1613            }
1614            temp=0;
1615            if(clipPoints != null)
1616            {
1617                for(j=0;j<clipPoints.size()-1;j++)
1618                {
1619                   pt2d0=clipPoints.get(j);
1620                   pt2d1=clipPoints.get(j+1);
1621                   pt0=new POINT2(pt2d0.getX(),pt2d0.getY());
1622                   pt1=new POINT2(pt2d1.getX(),pt2d1.getY());
1623                   temp=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
1624                }
1625            }
1626            else if(rect != null)
1627            {
1628                temp=rect.getMaxX()-rect.getMinX();
1629                if(temp < rect.getMaxY()-rect.getMinY())
1630                    temp=rect.getMaxY()-rect.getMinY();
1631            }
1632            if(temp>maxLengthClipArea)
1633                maxLengthClipArea=temp;
1634            if(maxLengthPixels > 0 && maxLengthClipArea > 0)
1635                factor=maxLengthClipArea/maxLengthPixels;
1636        }
1637        catch(Exception exc)
1638        {
1639            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "getZoomFactor",
1640                    new RendererException("Failed inside getZoomFactor", exc));
1641        }
1642        return factor;
1643    }
